ADSB_CALLSIGN_2.D: Sets second 4 characters of a total of 8. Valid characters are A-Z, 0-9, " " only. Example "TEST" -> 1413829460 For CALLSIGN shorter than 8 characters use the null terminator at the end '\0'.

ASPD_DO_CHECKS.D: Controls which checks are run to check airspeed data for validity. Only applied if ASPD_PRIMARY > 0. Bitmask:

ASPD_FP_T_WINDOW.d: First principle airspeed check time window.
ASPD_FP_T_WINDOW.D: Window for comparing airspeed change to throttle and pitch change. Triggers when the airspeed change within this window is negative while throttle increases and the vehicle pitches down. Is meant to catch degrading airsp

ASPD_FS_INNOV.D: This specifies the minimum airspeed innovation required to trigger a failsafe. Larger values make the check less sensitive, smaller values make it more sensitive. Large innovations indicate an inconsistency between predi

ASPD_FS_INTEG.D: This sets the time integral of airspeed innovation exceedance above ASPD_FS_INNOV required to trigger a failsafe. Larger values make the check less sensitive, smaller positive values make it more sensitive.

ASPD_FS_T_START.D: Delay before switching back to using airspeed sensor if checks indicate sensor is good. Set to a negative value to disable the re-enabling in flight.

ASPD_FS_T_STOP.D: Delay before stopping use of airspeed sensor if checks indicate sensor is bad.

ASPD_PRIMARY.d: Index or primary airspeed measurement source.

ASPD_SCALE_1.D: This is the scale IAS --> CAS of the first airspeed sensor instance

ASPD_SCALE_2.D: This is the scale IAS --> CAS of the second airspeed sensor instance

ASPD_SCALE_3.D: This is the scale IAS --> CAS of the third airspeed sensor instance

ASPD_SCALE_APPLY.d: Controls when to apply the new estimated airspeed scale(s).

ASPD_TAS_NOISE.d: Wind estimator true airspeed measurement noise.
ASPD_TAS_NOISE.D: True airspeed measurement noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector.

ASPD_WERR_THR.d: Horizontal wind uncertainty threshold for valid ground-minus-wind.
ASPD_WERR_THR.D: The airspeed alternative derived from groundspeed and heading will be declared valid as soon and as long the horizontal wind uncertainty is below this value.

ASPD_WIND_NSD.d: Wind estimator wind process noise spectral density.
ASPD_WIND_NSD.D: Wind process noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector. When unaided, the wind estimate uncertainty (1-sigma, in m/s) increases by this amount every second.

HIWONDER_EMM_EN.d: Enable the Hiwonder Encoder Motor Module (EMM) motor driver.

HTE_ACC_GATE.D: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

HTE_HT_ERR_INIT.D: Initial standard deviation of the hover thrust state estimate. Larger values allow the estimate to move farther from the initial hover thrust before process noise takes over.

HTE_HT_NOISE.D: Reduce to make the hover thrust estimate more stable, increase if the real hover thrust is expected to change quickly over time.

HTE_THR_RANGE.D: Defines the range of the hover thrust estimate around MPC_THR_HOVER. A value of 0.2 with MPC_THR_HOVER at 0.5 results in a range of [0.3, 0.7]. Set to a large value if the vehicle operates in varying physical conditions

HTE_VXY_THR.d: Horizontal velocity threshold for sensitivity reduction.
HTE_VXY_THR.D: Above this speed, the measurement noise is linearly increased to reduce the sensitivity of the estimator from biased measurement. Set to a low value on vehicles with large lifting surfaces.

HTE_VZ_THR.d: Vertical velocity threshold for sensitivity reduction.
HTE_VZ_THR.D: Above this speed, the measurement noise is linearly increased to reduce the sensitivity of the estimator from biased measurement. Set to a low value on vehicles affected by air drag when climbing or descending.

ICE_IDLE_RPM.d: Idle RPM setpoint for the engine.
ICE_IDLE_RPM.D: Applies a controller to prevent the RPM do drop below this value.

ICE_IDLE_RPM_I.d: Integral gain for idle RPM control.
ICE_IDLE_RPM_I.D: Ratio between integrated RPM error devided by 1000 to how much normalized output gets added to correct for it.

ICE_IDLE_RPM_P.d: Proportional gain for idle RPM control.
ICE_IDLE_RPM_P.D: Ratio between RPM error devided by 1000 to how much normalized output gets added to correct for it.

ICE_IDLE_THR_FF.D: Used as feed-forward. Should match approximately the throttle required to maintain the ICE_IDLE_RPM.

ICE_IGN_DELAY.d: Cold-start delay after ignition before engaging starter.
ICE_IGN_DELAY.D: In case that the ignition takes a moment to be up and running, this parameter can be set to account for that.

ICE_MIN_RUN_RPM.d: Minimum RPM for engine to be declared running.

ICE_RUN_FAULT_D.d: Fault detection if it stops in running state.
ICE_RUN_FAULT_D.D: Enables restart if a fault is detected during the running state. Otherwise commands continues in running state until given an user request off. Values:

ICE_STRT_ATTEMPT.d: Number attempts for starting the engine.
ICE_STRT_ATTEMPT.D: Number of accepted attempts for starting the engine before declaring a fault.

ICE_STRT_DUR.d: Duration of single starting attempt (excl. choking).
ICE_STRT_DUR.D: Maximum expected time for startup before declaring timeout.

ICE_STRT_THR.D: During the choking and the starting phase, the throttle value is set to this value.

RO_JERK_LIM.D: Set to -1 to disable. Note that if it is disabled the rover will not slow down when approaching waypoints in auto modes. For mecanum rovers this limit is used for longitudinal and lateral jerk.

RO_SPEED_RED.d: Tuning parameter for the speed reduction based on the course error.
